title: HeroSignatureCrownmarks
description: Historical alignment mapping linking each commander to their signature equipment crownmarks.

affinity_lore_unlocked.level_1: The scepter's crystal resonates when Maegan draws her ancestral blade, emitting a protective violet flash.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_3: As crown and crest align, her legion units inherit standard Vanguard immunity to direct fear debuffs.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_5: With all 5 signature items equipped, her visual portrait adapts, showcasing her true Sovereign Crownspire Vanguard armor.

affinity_lore_unlocked.level_1: The moonkeeper bow sings when touched by moonlight, granting marksmen arrows a minor freeze chance.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_3: The combined silver of her diadem and mantle emits a barrier that redirects the first curse back to its caster.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_5: Full 5-piece resonance transforms Lorelai's aura, highlighting floating lunar crescents and celestial moonbeams.

affinity_lore_unlocked.level_1: The dual daggers whisper in dark corridors, adding high armor piercing capabilities during cavalry flanks.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_3: Cowl and Cloak mesh together to render the squadron invisible on all regional radars.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_5: Maximum syndicate resonance triggers a phantom shadow mist on the map, concealing moving allied units.

affinity_lore_unlocked.level_1: The crucible's core flares when Remi triggers mechanical systems, burning down incoming shields.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_3: Chrono watch and goggles together allow engineers to detect trajectory hazards and speed up construction loops.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_5: Complete mechanical alignment triggers a copper clockwork halo, speeding up troop production speeds by 20%.

affinity_lore_unlocked.level_1: Voidbringer bow arrows draw shadows, stealing enemy commander mana on hit.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_3: Combined quiver and cloak siphon lifeforce from targets, recovering vital health of the front ranks.
affinity_lore_unlocked.level_5: Sovereign void-awakening triggers a vibrant dark pink aura, summoning three auxiliary shadow marksmen.
